Pancreatitis can occur in some patients that consume chocolate.
Expected course—12–36 hours, up to 72 hours in severe cases, depending on dosage and effectiveness of decontamination and treatment.
Prognosis—good if prompt oral decontamination occurs, but guarded with advanced signs of seizures and arrhythmias.
Methylxanthines cross the placenta and are excreted in milk.
